description: Lepton momentum-scale and resolution calibration on Z->ll (AN-16-442 3.1.4 and 5.3 adapted to UL16 PFNano): MC template fits of the data in the leg-bin-pair categories (user decision 2026-09-24), per-lepton least squares, iterated with the data corrected and the MC smeared per lepton until the residuals vanish; BW (x) DCB + exponential fits for the AN-style validation and the lambda calibration.

extract.comment: Loose preselection of the compact pair ntuple, looser than every tight selection the calibration may use; the trigger is the analysis OR of the skim analysis configuration

selection.comment: Control-pair legs: the AN tight lepton with the stage-2 floors.  Muon id an_tight: PF muon and (global, or tracker with a matched station); electron id: mvaFall17V2noIso WP90 until the stage-4b choice.  Thresholds apply to the transformed (data corrected, MC smeared) pT

bins.comment: Lower pT edges; the terminal pT bin and the terminal eta bin are unbounded, internal boundaries half-open [low, high).  Electrons are binned in abs(eta_SC).  Bin index k = ipt * n_eta + ieta.

histogram.comment: Data role at mass_bins (0.25 GeV), MC role at mc_template_bins (0.05 GeV point masses of the templates); 1800/360 is an integer, so the MC rebins exactly to the data binning.

lambda.comment: AN 5.3 categories of the per-event mass-uncertainty calibration: a leg's region from its abs(eta) (electrons abs(eta_SC)) and, for electrons, its relative pT error class; pairs fill the 2D (mass, predicted sigma_m/m) histogram of their unordered region pair

template_fit.comment: Window from the data mode ([mode - below, mode + above], clipped to window_clip inside the extraction window 50-130 GeV); kernel reference variance E_ref = kernel_reference_rel_sigma^2 of the MC point masses, exact template above it and second-order continuation below; E bounded to [-e_min_over_e_ref * E_ref, e_max], ln k to +-lnk_limit

validation_fit.comment: AN-style BW (x) DCB + exponential validation fits (functions and limits after efficiency_tnp_an): window seeded from the data mode, the MC of a category fitted in the window of its data, own numerical convolution (no FFTW plugin in the lxplus ROOT)

superseded: Superseded by calibration_ul16_v2.json (calib_v2).  This file is the calib_v1 configuration embedded in production_v3/calibration/v1/extract/plan.json (sha256 2a36888b..., fnv1a64 46bd5763...) with two interim in-place edits of its fit sections on 2026-09-24 (recorded in experiment_log.md); it is used by no product.
